Narodil jsem se v roce 1952 v Hradci Krá: I was born in Hradec Králové in 1952. After completing my general secondary education in Brno, I studied at the Střední odborná škola kamenosochařská (Secondary School of Stone Carving and Sculpture) in Hořice v Podkrkonoší from 1970 to 1974.
V letech 1974–1980 jsem studoval na Akad: From 1974 to 1980, I studied sculpture at the Academy of Fine Arts in Prague, specialising in the conservation and restoration of stone sculpture.
Od roku 1981 vykonávám samostatnou činno: I have practised independently in this field since 1981.
Restaurátorské práce provádím na základě: I undertake conservation and restoration work under Ministry of Culture of the Czech Republic licences nos. 6278/91 and 8.001/96. Work on cultural monuments is carried out in accordance with Act No. 20/1987 Coll. on State Heritage Preservation, as amended.
